# SOP-P1-L1-04 - Shift handover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Purpose
1. Provide consistent, auditable shift-to-shift handover for the Hot Forge line.

Preconditions
2. Incoming and outgoing operators must have completed required training and are authorized for P1-L1 operations per SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-02.
3. Equipment status confirmed available in CMMS and maintenance references reviewed in MM-P1-L1-IH03.

PPE
4. Required PPE for handover and brief inspection:
   4.1. Use hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, eye protection, and steel-toe footwear.
   4.2. Follow additional PPE requirements posted at each station.

Shift Handover Steps
5. Step 1 — Initial overview
   5.1. Outgoing operator summarizes current production batch, shift yield, and any deviation noted during the shift.
   5.2. Note any in-process parts or billets staged at EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, or EQ-P1-L1-IH03.

6. Step 2 — Equipment condition and consumables
   6.1. Confirm visual condition of EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and record any anomalies.
   6.2. Verify lubricant part numbers for referenced equipment:
       - The lubricant part number for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is CFW-LUB-188.
       - The lubricant part number for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is CFW-LUB-508.
   6.3. Report any low or depleted consumables to maintenance per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

7. Step 3 — Safety and quality issues
   7.1. Review any safety incidents, near misses, or quality rejects.
   7.2. Ensure any containment or hold tags are identified and location communicated.

8. Step 4 — Actions and follow-up
   8.1. List outstanding actions, responsible person, and required reference document: SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-02, MM-P1-L1-IH03.

Sign-off
9. Both outgoing and incoming operators must sign and time the handover record. Include operator names, start/end of handover, and any immediate actions agreed.

Change history
10. Rev A — Initial release.
